actions.name: check
actions.purpose: Has a judge look at images through evidence tools and conclude: pass, fail or unsure.

arguments.name: tools
arguments.purpose: The evidence tools the judge may call, by name, separated by commas.

arguments.name: judge
arguments.purpose: The judge to ask; without it, the configured default.

arguments.name: use_case
arguments.purpose: general, or a use case of the table: source-fidelity, reference-consistency, reality-checks, brief-compliance or product-fidelity.

arguments.name: job
arguments.purpose: Under a use case of the table, the job in the contract job/1: its brief, its requirements, and its images in the order of the inputs, with their roles.

arguments.name: details
arguments.purpose: none, or first: before the first turn, the tools named by detail are run on each pair of images the use case relates, and what they measured opens the conversation.

arguments.name: detail
arguments.purpose: The details measured first, separated by commas: align, and the two comparisons that run align first, for a pair; or tiles, for one image: its candidate in four tiles by view.

arguments.name: projection
arguments.purpose: How a call of align by the judge is answered: full, or visual only, its pictures and a fixed sentence (squint's projection of arm C).

arguments.name: second_look
arguments.purpose: off, on, or strict: one more turn, in the run's budget, to settle items a submission left tentative; strict settles toward pass only with a cited location.

arguments.name: measured
arguments.purpose: What an earlier step of a recipe measured first, bound to its measurements alone: said to the judge before its first turn once held to the runs that made it.

arguments.name: recipe_digest
arguments.purpose: The digest of the recipe this run is a step of, which a recipe gives: kept in the decision cache's key.

arguments.name: cell
arguments.purpose: The cell of an evaluation matrix this run is, kept in its record: the matrix, set, item, judge, arm, repetition and attempt. check does not read it.

arguments.name: max_output_tokens
arguments.purpose: The most output tokens of one turn of the judge.

inputs.name: images
inputs.purpose: The images the judge is shown, and may look into.

inputs.name: measured_images
inputs.purpose: The images an earlier step measured first, as it handed them on: aligned frames, maps and tiles.

actions.use: To remove a thing you can name in words from a picture; give protect to keep what the mask would reach; until feather gives the mask alone.

actions.name: align
actions.purpose: Registers one flat image onto another of the same scene and viewpoint, and returns it warped into the other's frame.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image to register, usually the candidate.

inputs.name: against
inputs.purpose: The image to register onto, usually the source: the aligned frame shares its grid.

outputs.name: aligned
outputs.purpose: The image warped into the other's grid, when the pair registers.

actions.name: change_map
actions.purpose: Shows where two images in one grid differ in structure: a grey map, bright where the locally normalised luminance disagrees.

inputs.name: frame
inputs.purpose: The image whose grid the comparison is made in, usually the source.

inputs.name: against
inputs.purpose: The image compared with it, usually the candidate aligned onto it.

outputs.name: map
outputs.purpose: The map, in the grid of frame: bright is different, dark the same.

actions.name: edge_similarity
actions.purpose: Scores how much two images in one grid share the same edges: 1 for the same structure, near 0 for unrelated ones.

inputs.name: frame
inputs.purpose: The image whose grid the comparison is made in, usually the source.

inputs.name: against
inputs.purpose: The image compared with it, usually the candidate aligned onto it.

actions.name: details
actions.purpose: Measures the details of a use case's images before its judge looks, and hands on what each tool found.

arguments.name: use_case
arguments.purpose: The use case of the table whose pairs are measured.

arguments.name: job
arguments.purpose: The job in the contract job/1: its images in the order of the inputs, with their roles.

arguments.name: details
arguments.purpose: none, which measures nothing, or first.

arguments.name: detail
arguments.purpose: The details measured, separated by commas: align and the two comparisons that run align first, for each pair; or tiles, for a job with one image.

inputs.name: images
inputs.purpose: The job's images, in its order.

outputs.name: images
outputs.purpose: The images the details made, in the order the measurements name them: aligned frames, maps and tiles.

actions.name: close
actions.purpose: Closes the core of a mask by a disc, so gaps and notches narrower than the disc fill in.

arguments.name: radius_px
arguments.purpose: The radius of the disc, in pixels of the mask's image, from 0 to 10000.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask whose core is closed.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The mask with the closed core, its blend cleared and its protect kept.

actions.name: feather
actions.purpose: Sets the blend of a mask to a feather of its core's edge, outward, with one sigma.

arguments.name: sigma_px
arguments.purpose: The feather's sigma, in pixels of the mask's image, from 0.1 to 10000.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask whose core's edge is feathered.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The mask with the new blend, its core and its protect kept.

actions.name: grow
actions.purpose: Grows the core of a mask by a disc, and further downward for a shadow.

arguments.name: px
arguments.purpose: The radius of the disc, in pixels of the mask's image, from 0 to 10000.

arguments.name: down_px
arguments.purpose: How many pixels further down the grown core reaches, from 0 to 10000.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask whose core is grown.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The mask with the grown core, its blend cleared and its protect kept.

actions.name: plug
actions.purpose: Fills the holes of a mask's core up to a share of the area of the shape around each.

arguments.name: max_share
arguments.purpose: The largest hole filled, as a share of the area of the shape around it, from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask whose holes are filled.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The mask with its small holes filled, its blend cleared and its protect kept.

actions.name: render
actions.purpose: Makes a mask into a picture: the image cut out by it (alpha), or its weight in grey (plain).

arguments.name: profile
arguments.purpose: alpha: the image with the mask's weight as alpha; plain: the weight in grey.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask to render.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image the mask is on, which alpha requires.

outputs.name: image
outputs.purpose: The rendering, an image whose role is a rendering.

actions.name: resize
actions.purpose: Scales an image down to a long edge, so the whole picture can be seen at once.

arguments.name: long_edge
arguments.purpose: The longer side of the result in pixels, under the image's own.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image to scale down.

outputs.name: resized
outputs.purpose: The whole image at the size asked.

actions.name: segment
actions.purpose: Finds each instance a phrase, a point or a box asks for in an image, as one mask for each.

arguments.name: kind
arguments.purpose: What the query is: phrase, point or box.

arguments.name: query
arguments.purpose: A phrase in words; a point as X Y; a box as left top right bottom; in pixels.

arguments.name: max_instances
arguments.purpose: The most instances to find, from 1 to 64.

arguments.name: backend
arguments.purpose: The segmenter, by its name in the config; the default when not given.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The picture to look in.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: One mask for each instance found, its core the instance.

actions.name: select
actions.purpose: One mask from the instance masks to keep: the union of their cores, minus exclude boxes.

arguments.name: exclude
arguments.purpose: Boxes cleared from the core, in pixels: left top right bottom, boxes apart by ;.

arguments.name: at
arguments.purpose: Keeps only the masks whose core holds the pixel at X Y, in pixels of the image.

arguments.name: use_case
arguments.purpose: What the mask is for, recorded on it.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The instance masks to keep, all on one image.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The selection: the union of the cores, no blend and nothing protected.

actions.name: subtract
actions.purpose: Protects the pixels of a second mask or a location, grown by a margin; with neither the mask is unchanged.

arguments.name: grow_px
arguments.purpose: How far the second mask's support is grown, in pixels of the mask's image, from 0 to 10000.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask to protect pixels in.

inputs.name: subtract
inputs.purpose: A mask on the same image whose core and blend become protect.

inputs.name: location
inputs.purpose: A location on the same image whose inside becomes protect; not with subtract.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The mask with the larger protect, its core and blend cleared there.

actions.name: view
actions.purpose: Shows a region of an image closer, and the same region of a second image when one is given.

arguments.name: left
arguments.purpose: The left edge of the region, as a fraction of the width.

arguments.name: top
arguments.purpose: The top edge of the region, as a fraction of the height.

arguments.name: right
arguments.purpose: The right edge of the region, as a fraction of the width.

arguments.name: bottom
arguments.purpose: The bottom edge of the region, as a fraction of the height.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image to look into.

inputs.name: also
inputs.purpose: A second image to show the same region of.

outputs.name: crops
outputs.purpose: The region of each image, the first image's first.

actions.name: paste
actions.purpose: Pastes a fill onto its base image under a mask; every pixel the mask weighs nothing is the base's.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.purpose: How the fill is pasted: feather, by the mask's core and blend; hard, on the core alone; poisson, by the fill's gradients.

arguments.name: constants
arguments.purpose: The constant set poisson takes its tolerance and its ceiling of iterations from.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The base image.

inputs.name: fill
inputs.purpose: The fill: a picture of the base's size, read only where the mask weighs over 0.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask, on the base.

outputs.name: image
outputs.purpose: The composite, or the base when the fill changed nothing.

actions.name: fill
actions.purpose: Fills what a mask covers in an image with the configured filler, and rebinds the mask onto the result.

arguments.name: backend
arguments.purpose: The filler, by its name in the config; the default when not given.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The picture to fill.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask on the picture: the filler paints where it weighs over 0.

outputs.name: image
outputs.purpose: The composite, or the picture when the fill changed nothing.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The mask, rebound onto the composite.

actions.name: cut
actions.purpose: Cuts a panorama at its seam: its last and first strips side by side on a flat canvas whose middle column is the seam.

arguments.name: strip
arguments.purpose: The strip as a share of the panorama's width, over 0 and at most 0.5; the strip is made even, at least 2 and at most a quarter of the width, twice.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: A complete panorama, at least 4 columns wide.

outputs.name: image
outputs.purpose: The canvas: the panorama's last strip, then its first.

outputs.name: plan
outputs.purpose: The panorama and the strip, for put.

actions.name: put
actions.purpose: Puts a cut's canvas back onto its panorama; nothing outside the two strips changes.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The panorama the plan was made for.

inputs.name: canvas
inputs.purpose: The canvas, the cut wherever the mask weighs nothing.

inputs.name: plan
inputs.purpose: The plan cut handed back.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask the canvas was worked through: on the cut, or rebound from it onto the canvas.

outputs.name: image
outputs.purpose: The panorama with the canvas put back, or the panorama when nothing changed.

actions.name: window
actions.purpose: Crops an image and its mask around the mask's support, with context; the mask handed back places the crop onto the image.

arguments.name: max_side
arguments.purpose: The largest side of the window in pixels; a support larger than it is refused. Unset: the image's.

arguments.name: context
arguments.purpose: The context on each side of the support, as a share of its width and height, from 0 to 4; unset, the constant set's.

arguments.name: constants
arguments.purpose: The constant set the context is taken from when the call does not give it.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image to window.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask on the image whose support the window is built around.

outputs.name: image
outputs.purpose: The crop of the image.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The mask's planes cut to the crop, on the crop, placing it onto the image.

actions.name: unwindow
actions.purpose: Writes a crop back into exactly the box of the image window cut it from; nothing outside the box changes.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image the window was cut from.

inputs.name: crop
inputs.purpose: The crop to write back: the window's, wherever its mask weighs nothing.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask window handed back, which places its crop onto the image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.purpose: The image with the crop written back, or the image when nothing changed.

actions.name: apply
actions.purpose: Performs a mask's prescriptions on its image, once each and in order, and rebinds the mask onto the working image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image to work on.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask on the image, carrying the prescriptions.

outputs.name: image
outputs.purpose: The working image, or the image when nothing changed.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The mask, rebound onto the working image.

actions.name: line
actions.purpose: A line location on an image: a whole column or a path, with its full width in pixels.

arguments.name: column
arguments.purpose: The column, in pixels from the image's left edge, for a line from top to bottom.

arguments.name: column_share
arguments.purpose: The column as a share of the image's width, from 0 to 1, in place of column: 0.5 is the middle.

arguments.name: path
arguments.purpose: Two or more points in pixels of the image, X Y, points apart by ;.

arguments.name: width_px
arguments.purpose: The line's full width in pixels, more than 0 and at most the image's diagonal.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image the line is on.

outputs.name: location
outputs.purpose: The line location.

actions.name: rect
actions.purpose: A box as a location on an image, from its left, top, right and bottom edges in pixels.

arguments.name: box
arguments.purpose: The box in pixels of the image: left top right bottom, as segment prints a box.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image the box is on.

outputs.name: location
outputs.purpose: The box as a location.

actions.name: stroke
actions.purpose: A stroke location on an image: a rough mark along a path, with a radius in pixels.

arguments.name: path
arguments.purpose: Two or more points in pixels of the image, X Y, points apart by ;.

arguments.name: radius_px
arguments.purpose: The stroke's radius in pixels, more than 0 and at most the image's diagonal.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image the stroke is on.

outputs.name: location
outputs.purpose: The stroke location.

actions.name: rasterize
actions.purpose: A location's inside as the core of a new mask: a box or polygon as drawn, a line as a band, a stroke widened.

arguments.name: use_case
arguments.purpose: What the mask is for, recorded on it.

inputs.name: location
inputs.purpose: The location to rasterize.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image the location is on.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The mask whose core is the location's inside; no blend and nothing protected.

actions.name: shrink
actions.purpose: Shrinks the core of a mask by a disc; a core against the border shrinks from it too.

arguments.name: px
arguments.purpose: The radius of the disc, in pixels of the mask's image, from 0 to 10000.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask whose core is shrunk.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The mask with the shrunk core, its blend cleared and its protect kept.

actions.name: invert
actions.purpose: The mask for a second pass: what the first mask reached is protected, and every other pixel is the core.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The first pass's mask, on the image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image of the second pass: after a fill, its composite.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The second pass's mask: the first's reach protected, the rest the core.

actions.name: tighten
actions.purpose: Tightens a stroke to the defect's edges: at each sample the two strongest opposite edges inside the stroke bound the core.

arguments.name: min_contrast
arguments.purpose: The least size of the luminance's derivative, in levels per pixel, an edge must have to count.

arguments.name: min_defect_px
arguments.purpose: The narrowest defect, in pixels between its two edges.

arguments.name: max_defect_factor
arguments.purpose: The widest defect, as a multiple of the stroke's radius (2 is the whole stroke).

arguments.name: path_sigma
arguments.purpose: The sigma, in samples, of the smoothing of the tightened extents along the path.

arguments.name: sample_spacing_px
arguments.purpose: The spacing of the samples along the path, in pixels.

arguments.name: constants
arguments.purpose: The constant set a number is taken from when the call does not give it.

inputs.name: stroke
inputs.purpose: The stroke, a location on the image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image the edges are read from.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The tightened stroke as the core of a mask for a repair; no blend and nothing protected.

actions.name: inspect
actions.purpose: A mask for the eye: the overlay on its image, the core's width on each row, and its counts in the journal.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask to inspect.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image the mask is on, which the overlay is drawn on.

outputs.name: overlay
outputs.purpose: The overlay, an image whose role is a rendering.

outputs.name: widths
outputs.purpose: The core's width on each row of the image, in pixels.

actions.name: fan
actions.purpose: Measures the band along a column line: a half-width for each row, wide on smooth surfaces where the sides differ, thin on detail.

arguments.name: object_edge
arguments.purpose: The object cap: the luminance step between two columns, in levels, that counts as an object's edge; 0 turns the cap off.

arguments.name: object_margin_px
arguments.purpose: How far short of an object's edge the band stops, in pixels at the reference width.

arguments.name: tex_low
arguments.purpose: The texture, in percent a pixel, at and under which the surface is wholly smooth.

arguments.name: tex_high
arguments.purpose: The texture at and over which the band stays at its least width.

arguments.name: wide_max
arguments.purpose: The widest half-width, as a share of the image's width; 0 keeps every row thin.

arguments.name: thin_px
arguments.purpose: The least half-width in pixels at the reference width, scaled by the image's width.

arguments.name: row_sigma
arguments.purpose: The smoothing of the two rulers along the rows, as a share of the height.

arguments.name: width_sigma
arguments.purpose: The smoothing of the half-width along the rows, as a share of the height.

arguments.name: ref_width
arguments.purpose: The image width the pixel constants were fitted at.

arguments.name: gate
arguments.purpose: Whether the tone step across the line gates the opening: a row whose sides agree stays thin.

arguments.name: constants
arguments.purpose: The constant set the values a call does not give are taken from.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image, which does not wrap: a cut's canvas, whose middle column is the seam.

inputs.name: line
inputs.purpose: The line on the image, a whole column.

outputs.name: band
outputs.purpose: The band profile.

actions.name: profile
actions.purpose: Makes the band mask of a band profile: the core at each row's half-width, the blend a feather whose sigma follows the row.

arguments.name: feather_ratio
arguments.purpose: The feather's sigma of a row as a share of its half-width, from 0.05 to 2; unset, the constant set's.

arguments.name: constants
arguments.purpose: The constant set the ratio is taken from when the call does not give it.

inputs.name: band
inputs.purpose: The band profile fan made.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The band mask, on the band's image, with the profile and its sigma kept.

actions.name: ramp
actions.purpose: Measures the colour step across a band mask's line, row by row, and adds it to the mask as a tone ramp for apply.

arguments.name: share
arguments.purpose: The share of the step each side moves toward the other at the line, from 0 to 1; unset, the constant set's.

arguments.name: ramp_sigma
arguments.purpose: The smoothing of the step along the rows, as a share of the height, from 0 to 1; unset, the constant set's.

arguments.name: constants
arguments.purpose: The constant set the values a call does not give are taken from.

inputs.name: image
inputs.purpose: The image the band was measured on.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The band mask on the image, with its band profile.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.purpose: The mask with the tone ramp added.

actions.name: measure
actions.purpose: Measures a seam or a composite: continuity, tone step, transition, texture match and drift, per row; none is a verdict.

arguments.name: set
arguments.purpose: The measures to run, separated by commas: continuity, tone step, transition, texture match and drift, each name of two words joined by an underscore; all five when not given.

arguments.name: constants
arguments.purpose: The constant set the measures read: the chroma floor of a hue, and the percentile.

inputs.name: after
inputs.purpose: The image to measure, of the mask's size: the composite or the healed cut.

inputs.name: before
inputs.purpose: The image before the heal or the paste, of the mask's size, for drift.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.purpose: The mask, with its band profile for the band's measures.

inputs.name: line
inputs.purpose: A whole column on the mask's image or on either image, for continuity; the profile's column without it.

outputs.name: continuity
outputs.purpose: The measure of this name per row, in ratio; absent when it was not asked, not applicable or measured nothing.

outputs.name: tone_step_dl
outputs.purpose: The measure of this name per row, in L; absent when it was not asked, not applicable or measured nothing.

outputs.name: tone_step_dchroma
outputs.purpose: The measure of this name per row, in chroma; absent when it was not asked, not applicable or measured nothing.

outputs.name: tone_step_dhue
outputs.purpose: The measure of this name per row, in degrees; absent when it was not asked, not applicable or measured nothing.

outputs.name: transition
outputs.purpose: The measure of this name per row, in ratio; absent when it was not asked, not applicable or measured nothing.

outputs.name: texture_match
outputs.purpose: The measure of this name per row, in ratio; absent when it was not asked, not applicable or measured nothing.

artifact_types.name: mask
artifact_types.purpose: What to change in an image (core), how the change fades (blend) and what to keep (protect), with the band profile and the prescriptions it carries.

artifact_types.name: location
artifact_types.purpose: Where something is in an image: a box, a polygon, a view, a line, a stroke, the whole image, or that it is absent.

artifact_types.name: image
artifact_types.purpose: A picture file held whole: a photograph, a composite or a crop; or a rendering of another artifact, which is never accepted in that artifact's place.

artifact_types.name: band_profile
artifact_types.purpose: A band along a line: its half-width for each row, with the line and the sampling windows it was measured through.

artifact_types.name: series
artifact_types.purpose: Values measured along the rows of an image, such as the width of a feather or the step of a tone ramp for each row.

artifact_types.name: plan
artifact_types.purpose: How a wrapped cut was taken from a panorama, and so how it goes back: the width of the strip taken from each side of the seam.
